definitions.explanation: The thick cotton jacket, trousers, and belt worn for judo. Made sturdy enough to withstand the gripping and throwing of the sport.

examples.japanese: {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I change into my judo uniform.

examples.japanese: {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: Tie the belt of the judo uniform firmly.

examples.japanese: {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投|な}げ{技|わざ}→投げ技：17228_nagewaza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられる→耐える：12087_taeru⟧よう、⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Judo uniforms are made of thick fabric so they can withstand throwing techniques.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧ (judo) + {着|ぎ} (clothing worn for an activity). The fabric is much thicker than a karate uniform because judo involves gripping the cloth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to put on a judo uniform
- {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧: the belt of a judo uniform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空手着|からてぎ}: karate uniform — thinner and lighter
- {道着|どうぎ}: martial-arts uniform — the general term for 〜{着|ぎ} worn in budo
